high_level_description: The image depicts a cozy indoor setting with a focus on a wooden side table. The table has a dark brown finish and features a square top with two open shelves below it. It is positioned on a patterned rug that has a traditional design with intricate floral and geometric patterns in shades of red, blue, and beige. To the left of the table, there is a potted plant with long, green leaves, placed in a round, terracotta-colored pot. The plant adds a touch of nature to the scene.
